fato_historico: 2008: Matti Saari kills ten people at a school in Finland before committing suicide.
energia_do_dia: The stars invite you to cultivate deep inner peace, perhaps by focusing on the healing power of light amidst shadows. It is a good time to nurture your spirit, turning past sorrows into lessons of compassion. Consider this a fresh start for your analytical mind to prioritize kindness and resilience in every small interaction you have.
frase_do_dia: Choose to let your light shine even on the cloudiest days.
significado_numero: A powerful number representing spiritual awakening and inner wisdom.
conselho: Focus on healing and spread warmth to those who need it most today.
